benchmark_metadata.unsandboxed_warning: [CẢNH BÁO / NOTICE] Harness runs unsandboxed. Prompt-only restriction ('do not read workspace') is NOT strong security proof; an unconfined model could technically access workspace files if capable. Each call runs with --cd into an empty scratch dir and --format json is kept for tool-event detection; calls that used tools are excluded from accuracy. Results must be interpreted with this architectural boundary in mind.
